content: WebKit: env(safe-area-inset-*) is non-zero only near notch/home-indicator edges and changes with rotation; viewport-fit=cover (default is auto, which auto-insets and paints body background into the inset) is required for edge-to-edge chrome like bottom navs. Pattern: plain padding fallback, then max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) inside @supports, env() declared after constant() historically; insets are not a replacement for margins (portrait rotation returns 0 side insets).
